data_source: Franke, Klozer, de Visser and Krug (2011), doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002134, Table S1
license: Creative Commons Attribution; copyright (2011) Franke et al.; see article copyright statement.
membership_source: de Visser et al. (1997), Results p.1502/Table4 p.1503; also arXiv:0807.3002v1 Table1 footnote1
conversion: pdftotext -layout; parse 10-field table rows (mutation count, eight bits, W); keep fwn=phe=lys=0, retain arg,pyr,leu,oli,crn; sort lexicographically; preserve printed W strings. CSV uses LF line endings.
fitness_for_test: ln(W); complete 32-genotype Boolean landscape; no filtering, imputation, threshold or random sampling.

additional_inputs.locator: Table 1, manuscript pp.32-33; CS I w column, genotype column; footnote1 defines loci.
additional_inputs.conversion: Transcribe the 32 Table1 rows only, retaining displayed decimal strings and strain order; header genotype,W; CRLF. No tie-breaking by the separately printed ranks.
additional_inputs.rights: Only numerical genotype/fitness facts are extracted; no license for the whole manuscript is asserted.

additional_inputs.data_publication: Ogbunugafor (2026), doi:10.1093/genetics/iyag140, Data availability; underlying Weinreich et al. (2006), doi:10.1126/science.1123539.
additional_inputs.conversion: Byte-identical author numerical table. Use first five 0/1 columns and ln(MIC); ignore log_MIC (base10) column. 11111 MIC=4100. No package data are edited.
additional_inputs.rights: Numerical measurements only; the author repository has no declared license. No repository-wide license is asserted or code redistributed.
